title: Scale: small plans, real spaces
sentences: A scale of 1 : 100 means one unit in the drawing represents 100 of the same units in reality.
The ratio is dimensionless only after both distances use the same unit.
Multiply a drawing length by the scale factor to find its actual length; divide to go back to the drawing.
Draw its length at a scale of 1 : 50.
12 cm × 50 = 600 cm = 6 m, matching the real room.
spoken: A scale of 1: 100 means one unit in the drawing represents 100 of the same units in reality.
The ratio is dimensionless only after both distances use the same unit.
Multiply a drawing length by the scale factor to find its actual length; divide to go back to the drawing.
Draw its length at a scale of 1: 50.
Drawing length equals 600 divided by 50 equals 12 centimeters.
12 centimeters times 50 equals 600 centimeters equals 6 meters, matching the real room.
